# Contributing to Curentis CloudFront Signer

First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! This is a  project managed in my spare time, so please keep things **low-pressure**. I may not respond immediately, but I do appreciate the input.

---

## 🛡️ Privacy & Communication
To keep things organized and respect everyone's privacy:
* **No Direct Emails:** Please do not send pull requests or bug reports to my personal email.
* **Use Issues:** If you find a bug or have a suggestion, please [open an issue](https://github.com/Curentis/cloudfront-signer/issues).
* **GitHub Discussions:** For general "how-to" questions, use the Discussions tab.

---

## 🛠️ How to Contribute

### 1. Reporting Bugs
* Check the existing issues to see if the bug has already been reported.
* If not, open a new issue. Include:
    * A quick summary of the problem.
    * Steps to reproduce the behavior.
    * What you expected to happen vs. what actually happened.

### 2. Suggesting Enhancements
I’m open to ideas! Please open an issue labeled `enhancement` before writing any code so we can discuss the direction first.

### 3. Pull Requests (PRs)
1. **Fork** the repository.
2. **Create a branch** for your fix (`git checkout -b fix/awesome-feature`).
3. **Commit your changes.** > **Note:** Please use a [GitHub no-reply email](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/setting-up-and-managing-your-github-user-account/managing-email-preferences/setting-your-commit-email-address) for your commits to keep your own email address private.
4. **Push** to the branch and open a Pull Request.

---

## 🕒 Expectations
* **Response Time:** This is a "best effort" project. I might take a few days (or weeks) to review PRs.
* **Code Style:** Try to keep your code consistent with the existing project structure.
